Like-for-Like Card Spend, July vs July

HardProQuerying BasicsSubqueries & CTEsConditional LogicAggregation & GroupingDate Functions

Card spend abroad grew enormously from July 2025 to July 2026 — but most of the markets that saw spend in July 2026 had none a year earlier, so the headline mixes growth with expansion. Retailers report like-for-like (same-store) growth for exactly this reason: only the units that traded in both periods.

Treat each merchant_country as a market. Using completed card payments (amount_gbp) in July 2025 and July 2026, return one row with exactly these 3 columns: comparable_markets (markets with spend in both Julys), all_markets_growth_pct (growth of total spend in all markets) and like_for_like_growth_pct (growth in the comparable markets only), both rounded to 1 decimal. Growth is (2026 − 2025) / 2025 × 100.
